verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs show it running inference on the user's own hardware: a local server on localhost:8080, a local Docker or binary runtime, and a tested CPU path that needs no GPU. However, no cited item explicitly says prompts and data never leave the device or that it runs fully offline, so the privacy half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party guarantee that data and prompts stay on the device, documented fully offline or air-gapped operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of local-only inference.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
Every feature ships a CPU path first. That path is tested in CI, on the hardware most people already have, and it is not a degraded fallback.
